name: Athens
summary: Visit the Acropolis in a cool part of the day, then use the museum to understand what you saw. The old-city lanes and food around Monastiraki make a relaxed second half.
seasonNote: Summer heat may affect site opening; spring and autumn are usually easier for exposed ruins.
arrival: Airport metro or express buses reach central Athens; allow extra time if connecting to a ferry at Piraeus.
gettingAround: Walk the archaeological core and use metro for larger hops. Keep travel to the port separate from sightseeing time.
cashTip: Cards are common; carry EUR notes for small food purchases and market spending.
foodTip: Try souvlaki, Greek salad, spinach pie and yoghurt; check seafood price units before ordering.
buyTip: Buy olive products, ceramics and food gifts; verify luggage and customs restrictions.

connections.note: About 1 hour airborne; ferries take several hours and are weather-dependent. Compare total door-to-door time.
